text:
Sam: Quick idea — run a 2-week microlaunch: webinar + seeded promptpacks + 25 free credits for first 1k signups. Keep it narrow: web devs + product managers.
Priya: love. what's primary KPI? activation rate -> 7-day token usage? :rocket:
Sam: target = 15% convert to first prompt run within 48h, baseline ~8%.
Noah: suggest 3 arms: (A) webinar + credits, (B) email-only credits, (C) promptpacks + nudge. randomize by signup cohort.
Ava: need launch post copy and hero promptpack samples. can marketing take copy by EOD?
Priya: I'll own email + landing. Sam can share promptpack names.
Sam: promptpack names: 'starter-code-gen', 'meeting-summarizer', 'product-spec-boiler'. short sample for social: "Ship smarter with Redwood — join our live lab, get free credits & starter promptpacks to build a working prototype in 1 hour." CTA -> Register.
Noah: routing note: inbound leads from webinar should mark utm=webinar_lab -> route to 'spark' cohort in HubSpot. @eng-analytics can you add a flow?
Ava: draft social post attached (link). also propose A/B test on 'free credits' vs 'promptpack' in headline.
Sam: small ops note: we can gate credits via promo code `LAB25` (valid 7 days). QA checklist — landing, promo code redeem, email drip, onboarding flow, promptpack import.
Priya: timeline?
Sam: kickoff Wed, assets by Fri, soft launch next Tue, webinar Thu.
Noah: I'll configure cohort splits & event tags. will add experiments in Console -> Launch Experiments.
Ava: copy snippet for hero: "Build a prototype with Redwood Inference — free credits + curated promptpacks. Seats limited."
Sam: perfect. last ask: can growth provide 500 seed invites? @growth-team
Priya: pinging growth. :eyes:
GrowthBot: growth-team added 500 invites to campaign 'lab_seed_q2'.
Sam: thanks. I'll make a tracker doc and share link here after lunch. :+1:
